months.name: Lin'Fey
months.description: Named after the Ancient Lin'Fey, creator of all plant life.

months.name: Hedros
months.description: Named after the Ancient Hedros, creator of water and all animal life that lives within it.

months.name: Drin
months.description: Named after the Ancient Drin, creator of clouds and the one who controls the weather.

months.name: Lof
months.description: Named after the Ancient Lof, creator of air and sky.

months.name: Umirian
months.description: Named after the Guardian Umir, Guardian of Humanity and Wielder of Light.

months.name: Alwynian
months.description: Named after the Great King Alwyn.

months.name: Elerian
months.description: Named after the Great King Alwyn's wife, Queen Elerian.

months.name: Larelian
months.description: Named after the Great King Alwyn's son, Prince Laralek.

months.name: Dina
months.description: Named after the Elvish word for “silent”.

months.name: Raven
months.description: Named after the Goddess of Death: The Raven Queen.

months.name: Ubrin
months.description: Named after the Ancient Ubrin, creator of space and stars.

months.name: Ta'Roc
months.description: Named after the Ancient Ta'Roc, the creator of rock and earth.

special_days.name: New Cycle
special_days.description: The first day of the year. A day to celebrate the beginning of the new year and the end of winter.

special_days.name: Spring Pendulum
special_days.description: The day that the light and darkness are balanced in the sky. Starting here there is less darkness and more sun.

special_days.name: Festival of Lanterns
special_days.description: A festival of lights that takes place in the middle of summer to celebrate the long hours of light that Umir brings the day.

special_days.name: Festival of Lanterns (Harvest)
special_days.description: A festival bringing in the final harvest and consuming the last large meal before the end of growth.

special_days.name: Midwinter's Feast
special_days.description: A single day representing the darkest day of the year, in the middle of Ubrin.
